thread:
release-bot: Scheduled deploy window starting now for service/llm-router v3.2.3. Planned FF strategy: soft-squeeze ramp 0% -> 5% -> 20% over 40m. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Notifying @sara @miguel @tim.

sara: ack. I'll watch latency and error-rate dashboards. tagging the runbook: https://internal.redwood/release/llm-router/v3.2.3

miguel: quick note — can we pin traffic to v3.1.9 on bucket X if we see >2% error spike? ops wants a `pin-on-error` guard.

anya: +1 for a pin threshold. Also suggest disabling heavy quantized model variant on first ramp step. Keeps token latency stable.

release-bot: Action plan updated. Steps: 1) toggle ff `llmroute_v3.squeezed` to 5% 2) monitor p50/p95 & 5xx 3) if 5xx delta > 1.5pp or latency +200ms -> auto-pin to v3.1.9 and scale down v3.2.3 pool.

ops-bot: preflight checks passed: infra health OK, GPU pool CPU mem headroom 28%.

miguel: command I'll run (manual toggle if needed):
```
/redwood toggle-feature --flag llmroute_v3.squeezed --pct 5 --note "soft-squeeze ramp step1"
```

tim: watching logs. will call rollback if we see model hallucination regression or semantic drift on eval set. have a small eval script running against canary.

sara: current dashboards: p95 token latency baseline 210ms -> 220ms at 5% (expected), 5xx steady. no anomalous traces so far.

ops-bot: alert rule armed: `llmroute.errors` will DM @miguel and trigger `release-bot pin` if rate >1.5% for 5m.

miguel: seen one spike 1.8% at 02:12, investigating trace IDs: trace-8a2, trace-8a7. Looks like a downstream cache miss. Not related to model.

anya: recommendation: hold at 5% for another 15m, then go to 20% if no regression.

release-bot: Proceeding to step 2: ramp to 20% in 20m window as flagged. Notifying release notes channel.

ops-bot: note: if auto-pin triggers, it will post a short message with reason and operator. Manual rollback command:
```
/release rollback service/llm-router --to-version v3.1.9 --reason "auto-pin or manual rollback"
```

tim: eval script shows no semantic drop on canary. green. go for 20% in 5m.

sara: ramping to 20% now. pinging SRE to keep eye on RPS. :eyes:

miguel: saw sustained errors 2.5% for 2m at 02:29 — I triggered manual pin to v3.1.9.

release-bot: Manual pin executed by miguel at 8450003375. Rolling back to v3.1.9 cohorts and draining v3.2.3. Posting short rollback note to release-notes: "v3.2.3 soft-squeeze halted due to increased error rate; pinned to v3.1.9 while we investigate cache misbehavior."

anya: filing bug with traces and sample inputs. assigning to infra-cache team.

ops-bot: deploy window still open. recommend we hold on reattempt until cache fix and one-day soak on staging.

sara: agreed. closing the loop: update roadmap ticket and release notes. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
